findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_firms, list_freelance_platforms, find_opportunities, search_news, list_studies, get_firm_intel · Private data: get_firm, get_concept_card, get_study, get_academy_module, find_sap_clients, get_sap_client_profile, get_firm_intel · Public sink: find_opportunities · Destructive: get_study, find_sap_clients.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_firms, list_freelance_platforms, find_opportunities, search_news, list_studies, get_firm_intel · Private data: get_firm, get_concept_card, get_study, get_academy_module, find_sap_clients, get_sap_client_profile, get_firm_intel · Public sink: find_opportunities · Destructive: get_study, find_sap_clients

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
